title: Emilio Jacinto biopic starring Gerald Santos submitted as MMFF entry
summary: The biopic of hero Emilio Jacinto, “Liwanag at Dilim,” was recently submitted to the MMFF, hopefully to make it as one of the official eight entries in this year’s festival.
